mapper.select: INSERT INTO move_request ( id, request_no, customer_id, status, origin_address, destination_address, desired_start_at, submitted_at ) VALUES ( #{id, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{requestNo}, #{customerId, jdbcType=OTHER}, 'SUBMITTED', #{originAddress}, #{destinationAddress}, #{desiredStartAt}, now() ) RETURNING created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO move_item ( id, move_request_id, appliance_type_id, quantity, installation_conditions ) VALUES ( #{id, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{moveRequestId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{applianceTypeId, jdbcType=OTHER}, 1, jsonb_build_object( 'carryingDistanceMeters', #{carryingDistanceMeters}, 'floorCount', #{floorCount}, 'additionalPipingMeters', #{additionalPipingMeters} ) )
mapper.select: SELECT mr.id, mr.request_no, mr.status, at.code AS appliance_type_code, at.name AS appliance_type_name, mr.origin_address, mr.destination_address, mr.desired_start_at, mr.created_at FROM move_request mr JOIN move_item mi ON mi.move_request_id = mr.id JOIN appliance_type at ON at.id = mi.appliance_type_id WHERE mr.customer_id = #{customerId, jdbcType=OTHER} ORDER BY mr.created_at DESC, mr.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM move_request WHERE customer_id = #{customerId, jdbcType=OTHER}

SELECT mr.id, mr.request_no, u.name AS customer_name, u.email AS customer_email, mr.status, item_summary.appliance_summary, mr.origin_address, mr.destination_address, mr.desired_start_at, mr.submitted_at, mr.created_at, current_reservation.id AS reservation_id, current_reservation.reservation_no, current_reservation.status AS reservation_status, current_assignment.status AS technician_assignment_status, current_assignment.technician_profile_id, current_assignment.technician_name, analysis.id AS analysis_id, analysis.status AS analysis_status, analysis.provider AS analysis_provider, analysis.model_name AS analysis_model_name, analysis.confidence AS analysis_confidence, analysis.result_json::text AS analysis_result_json, analysis.error_code AS analysis_error_code, analysis.error_message AS analysis_error_message, analysis.created_at AS analysis_created_at FROM move_request mr JOIN app_user u ON u.id = mr.customer_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT string_agg(at.name || ' × ' || mi.quantity, ', ' ORDER BY at.name) AS appliance_summary FROM move_item mi JOIN appliance_type at ON at.id = mi.appliance_type_id WHERE mi.move_request_id = mr.id ) item_summary ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.id, r.reservation_no, r.status FROM reservation r WHERE r.move_request_id = mr.id ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'RESCHEDULE_REQUESTED') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) current_reservation ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ta.status, tp.id AS technician_profile_id, technician.name AS technician_name FROM technician_assignment ta JOIN technician_profile tp ON tp.id = ta.technician_id JOIN app_user technician ON technician.id = tp.user_id WHERE ta.reservation_id = current_reservation.id ORDER BY ta.assigned_at DESC, ta.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) current_assignment ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT aa.id, aa.status, aa.provider, aa.model_name, aa.confidence, aa.result_json, aa.error_code, aa.error_message, aa.created_at FROM ai_analysis aa WHERE aa.move_request_id = mr.id ORDER BY aa.created_at DESC, aa.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) analysis ON true WHERE (NOT #{reviewRequired} OR mr.status = 'NEEDS_REVIEW' OR analysis.status IN ('FAILED', 'NEEDS_REVIEW')) ORDER BY mr.created_at DESC, mr.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT count(*) FROM move_request mr LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT aa.status FROM ai_analysis aa WHERE aa.move_request_id = mr.id ORDER BY aa.created_at DESC, aa.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) analysis ON true WHERE (NOT #{reviewRequired} OR mr.status = 'NEEDS_REVIEW' OR analysis.status IN ('FAILED', 'NEEDS_REVIEW'))
